no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application since there were no controversial issues raised by the application that would benefit from an advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for ODOMZO (sonidegib, NDA205266). The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all explicitly state the Division did not refer the application to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC), because the drug is not first in its class, the efficacy outcome measures and safety profile were acceptable, and the application raised no controversial issues or significant public health questions. Accordingly, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
